source.manualTitle: Samsung Top-Load Washer CG71 Family (WA7000A) (WA55CG71, WA55CG75, WA54CG)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Power cycle
steps.body: Unplug 1 minute and retry. PC = clutch position not detected; PC1 = hall signal incorrect after detection.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug 1 minute and retry. PC = clutch position not detected; PC1 = hall signal incorrect after detection.

steps.title: Clutch and harness
steps.body: Inspect clutch assembly, hall sensor wiring, and motor module connections.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect clutch assembly, hall sensor wiring, and motor module connections.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace clutch/motor module or main PBA.

steps.title: Replace clutch module
steps.oemOutcome: Replace clutch or motor module when PC/PC1 persists.
